article.title: How the upcoming U.S. and Israeli elections could lead to the third round of the Iran war
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: The upcoming U.S. and Israeli elections will likely lead Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu to renew their misguided war on Iran with even greater ferocity than before in an effort to save their political lives.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
